claims.Finding: The manager at RCX contains eight 16-byte records starting at+8, each with an external attack-object cell at record+8. The loop remembers the last empty record but stops at the first occupied record matching object DWORD+200 and Decode(object DWORD+20). A selected existing object is reused only when object DWORD+24 and record DWORD+0 match the requested arguments. Otherwise3D0EB0 is called to request marking, a728-byte object is allocated, and40F1C0 receives the exact address of the selected QWORD cell as argument5. Before allocation, DWORD at Decode(manager DWORD+0)+3312 is cleared without a local null check. The constructor result overwrites the cell and its DWORD+36 is copied to manager+4.
claims.Limitations: The local body has no recovery when all eight cells are occupied without a matching record: the retained record address remains zero. A failed allocation also reaches a null+36 read. Reachability under normal scripts, all allocation contracts and external ordering remain unproved. The fifth argument is an interior manager cell, not a separately allocated ownership token.
